decision: Selected the BEV Adressregister point for 1100 Wien, Computerstraße 4, the address NTT DATA publishes for Vienna 1, as the site locator. It marks the registered address, not the building outline.

consistency_checks.operator_description: NTT's page says Vienna 1 'is situated in the south-west region of the capital and is approximately 6km from the city center'; the point is in the 10th district (Favoriten), in the south of Vienna, about 6 km from the centre, consistent with the operator text.

identity_bridge: NTT DATA's Vienna 1 page (version of 22 October 2026, captured 7 November 2026) and the Internet Archive copy of 12 June 2026 of its predecessor give 'Computerstrasse 4, 1100 Vienna, Austria'.
The BEV address search for 'Computerstraße 4 1100 Wien' (layer ADR) returns exactly one address feature.
